svg.title: Mobility Decision Copilot — implemented architecture, 2026-09-05
svg.desc: React uses the Spring API and bounded async brief jobs. The Java workflow uses process-local DuckDB and bounded optional Sarvam assistance. PostgreSQL shares mutable control state. Human approval and revalidation precede mock action execution. Proposed publication and incident features are shown separately.
svg.text: Implemented runtime · Java 21 / Spring Boot + React / TypeScript · D-048 · 2026-09-05

g.text: 01 EXPERIENCE
Morning brief • governed comparison charts • Investigation • Ask + evidence drawers • Approval • Audit • Trust
Async polling and cancellation • keyboard focus / reduced motion • leadership clipboard and text export
02 API + ASYNC BRIEF ADMISSION
Registry identity / tenant and role checks → POST /api/v1/brief-jobs → identity-scoped reuse or 202 queued
BriefJobStore: in-memory OR PostgreSQL • bounded admission • default 2 brief workers • sync routes retained
03 CONTROLLED JAVA WORKFLOW
18 nodes • Supervisor → Investigator → Critic → Briefing
7 registered workers • shared bounded investigation executor
Governed evidence → verify → render verified claims → policy
OPTIONAL SARVAM ASSISTANCE
LanguageModelPort • sarvam-105b
Server-side key • JSON / timeout / concurrency
Deterministic fallback • tokens / estimated cost
04 PROCESS-LOCAL ANALYTICS
Immutable official CSVs → normalization → DuckDB
M01–M18 / prior four complete weeks / G1–G3
Metric cache: 2,048 entries • capability cache: 128
Ten-minute TTL • tenant / window / version scope
05 HUMAN CONTROL + RECOVERY
Human decision → fresh revalidation → idempotent mock effect
PostgreSQL: jobs, checkpoints, rich snapshots, approvals, audit
Local alternative: in-memory control repositories
Completed / paused run recovery • no blind crash replay
06 TRUST + VERIFICATION
Redacted node/tool traces • optional Langfuse • provider attempts / fallback / token accounting
Official checksum + metric gates • tenant isolation • approval / duplicate-effect tests • restart and UI checks
PROPOSED EXTENSIONS — NOT IMPLEMENTED
Versioned dataset publication + last-good rollback • persistent DQ provenance • incident follow-up
Keep PostgreSQL for shared mutable state • an executed mock action does not mean an incident is resolved

svg.text: Always join / aggregate by (business_unit, trip_id) · No live Sarvam benchmark claimed · No external vendor communication
